ayuda: Tap a piece or drag across the bar to mark what you don't need, then remove it. "Cut here" splits the piece at the playhead. Striped parts don't go in the clip; the ✕ puts them back.
ayudaEtiqueta: How to cut inside the clip
ayudaCortarAca: Splits the piece at the playhead, so you can pick just one part and remove it
noQuitarTodo: At least 1 s of the clip has to stay.
ayudaSilencios: Finds the long silences in the clip and marks them as cuts. You can review them one by one afterwards.
sinSilencios: No long silences found in the clip.
errorSilencios: Couldn't look for silences. Try again.
silenciosMarcados: {n, plural, one {# silence} other {# silences}} marked ({seg} s). Review them; they save on their own like everything else.
